name: Roane State Community College
oos_note: Public JUCO. Non-resident (out-of-state) tuition & fees, full-time 12 credit hours, 2026-27 academic year (Fall 2026-Summer 2027): $4,104 tuition + $178 fees = $4,282/semester x 2 = $8,564/year. Source: Roane State official Tuition and Fee Listing page (roanestate.edu/?9185-Tuition-and-Fee-Listing). Excludes room/board.
